body.text: Original fictional prompt: one visitor draws a circle; another leaves a gap. What would you keep open?

activity_offer.title: A reading table
activity_offer.purpose: Read the prompt and, if you choose, discuss one joint interpretation.
activity_offer.offered_scope: Read and discuss this permitted fictional prompt in this room.
activity_offer.limitations: No contribution or agreement is required; no outside access is offered.
